supporting_observations.claim: FILE-HD-01 launched the installed CobaltVault agent as HARBOR-DENTAL\svc-bkp with a Nightly job targeting ingest.cobaltvault.net shortly before the alert window.

The recorded CobaltVault-related proxy activity was brief: a CONNECT to ingest.cobaltvault.net returned 24,228 tunnel bytes server-to-client, followed by a GET with status 200; a later CONNECT received status 407, and the agent process exited at 13:45:58.826 UTC. These records do not demonstrate a successful transfer of hundreds of MB around 13:46 UTC.
The supplied records do not identify a network flow carrying the alerted hundreds-of-MB transfer or establish that it was generated by the CobaltVault agent.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include the alert's underlying flow record with its destination, byte count, and connection interval, so the reported volume cannot be independently matched to a process or destination.
The available proxy records provide limited session details and do not establish the contents or total size of any uploaded data.
The available process and network records do not provide CobaltVault job-completion or file-selection details.
claims_not_established: Whether the alerted transfer was the scheduled/approved CobaltVault backup or a separate outbound activity.
Whether hundreds of MB were successfully transmitted, to which destination, and what data was involved.
Whether the CobaltVault agent's recorded short proxy sessions represent all of its network activity during the alert.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the network alert's raw flow or sensor record, including source and destination addresses, ports, byte counts, and start/end times.
Retrieve complete proxy records for FILE-HD-01 around 13:20–14:20 UTC, including upload/request byte counts and any related sessions.
Review CobaltVault job and audit logs for the Nightly run, including completion status, uploaded objects, and byte totals.
Correlate endpoint process-to-network telemetry for FILE-HD-01 during the alert interval to identify the process responsible for the reported transfer.
unrelated_findings: FILE-HD-01 made proxy requests bearing GlobalProtect and Zscaler client user agents; these services are not listed as approved in the supplied environment context and merit a separate review. These records do not establish that either service caused the alerted transfer. (T010-00123, T010-00234, T010-00271, T010-00277)

FILE-HD-01 made a brief proxy CONNECT to downloads.cloud.com with a curl user agent, an unapproved cloud service in the supplied context; review separately. This does not establish a connection to the alerted transfer. (T010-00515, T010-00516)

A TLS connection from PROXY-HD-01 to FILE-HD-01 on port 443 appears in the records near 14:17 UTC; its purpose and process are not established here and it is outside the evidenced CobaltVault activity. (T010-00668, T010-00669)
